entries.scope: Cross-platform document-tool registries, Linux Cargo fallback, Windows required-drift status, operator documentation and shared agent guidance
entries.rationale: Pandoc and Typst CLI are required on every supported platform; Tinymist Typst is the required VS Code extension while the standalone server remains optional. Windows now returns exit 1 for required package, CLI or extension drift.
readerPaths: Daily maintenance -> platform preview -> document-tool manpage
entries.navigationImpact: Adds document-tool sections to the existing bilingual maintenance guide and platform manpages; no new entry point or script.
entries.languageStrategy: German first with English following in shared guidance and manpages; synchronized language partners for the maintenance overview.
entries.platformAndExampleProof: macOS Bash syntax, actual dry-run, isolated Linux Cargo and extension fixtures, portable PowerShell comparison functions and analyzer; real Pandoc-to-Typst-to-PDF smoke test with checksum-verified temporary Typst. Native Windows and Linux installs remain unverified.
entries.risk: Linux distro Rust may be too old for a locked Cargo build; a failed build remains required drift. A generated PDF alone does not establish accessibility. Source implementation does not establish installation or fleet delivery.
entries.reevaluationTrigger: Document-tool publisher/package IDs, upstream Rust requirements, VS Code server packaging, installer contract or maintenance distribution changes.
